title: Work tape after an action
statement: Given an action consisting of a captured output value and a head movement, a work tape $t:ℤ	oOption(Bool)$, and a head position $p	oℤ$, define the resulting tape as the work tape obtained by applying that action to a one-tape configuration whose state is absent, whose output is empty, and whose sole work tape and head position are $t$ and $p$.
caveat: The imported definitions of actions and their tape-update semantics are not included, so the exact meaning of the captured output component cannot be made more explicit.
